chunks: Abu Ali al-Ash'ari, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Ubays ibn Hisham, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Clean their pens and wipe their dust (from their fur).'

key_terms.رُغَام: Dust, dirt, or dried mucus that accumulates on the fur/nose of animals; material wiped away during grooming
key_terms.مَرَابِض: Plural of marbaḍ — the resting place, pen, or enclosure where animals (especially sheep and camels) lie down

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about cleaning sheep pens and caring for sheep in Islam?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) transmits a saying of the Prophet (SAWW) instructing believers to maintain cleanliness in the pens and resting places of sheep, and to wipe away dust and debris from their wool. This hadith is found in the chapter on sheep in al-Kafi's section on animals, reflecting the Prophet's emphasis on the welfare and hygiene of livestock under human care. The instruction reflects the Islamic principle that animals in one's custody deserve proper care and cleanliness.
